title: Rodian Aftermath
problem: Its "+30% damage per death" block is gated on Oathbreaker (1797): Rodian Aftermath does nothing, Oathbreaker holders get its bonus. Confirmed in game (2026-10-20).
notes: Fix: K: gate constant 1797 → 1798 (new static value in the .text tail cave) — in patch (byte-verified)

release_notes.intended: The holder deals 30% more damage for each death this battle.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the bonus was tied to Oathbreaker instead: Rodian Aftermath did nothing and Oathbreaker holders got the bonus.
release_notes.fix: Now Rodian Aftermath holders get the bonus, and Oathbreaker no longer does.
